newsitem.title: BELGIUM: W. Europe Q1 paper/board output up 5.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: W. Europe Q1 paper/board output up 5.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Western Europe's production of paper and board rose 5.3 percent to 19.1 million tonnes in the first quarter of 1997 compared with the same time last year, the Confederation of European Paper Industries said on Thursday.
The figure was 3.4 percent above the level in the fourth quarter of last year.
"Very strong overall production of paper and board in Europe continued well into 1997," CEPI said in a publication covering production statistics for the January-March period.
Newsprint and uncoated mechanical were the only sectors showing a decline in production, down by 1.4 and 6.4 percent respectively compared with the first quarter 1996.
"When compared to the fourth quarter of 1996 even these sectors are showing growth figures," CEPI said.
Pulp production rose 8.5 percent to 8.7 million tonnes year-on-year.
